product.role: Staple food, feed and industrial uses

BTN.stock_note: FAO's accounts put this country's opening stocks for 2024 at almost nothing, after several years in the millions or hundreds of thousands of tonnes. In these accounts the change in stocks is the figure that makes everything else balance, so a drop like that is usually the accounting closing, not the silos emptying. We publish no stock figure for this country this year rather than one we do not believe.
BTN.name: Bhutan

CHL.stock_note: FAO's accounts record this country as holding under a week of use in store at the start of 2024, against a supply in the millions of tonnes. For a buyer this size that is almost certainly a placeholder rather than an estimate, so we publish no stock figure for it rather than one that would read as an emergency.
CHL.name: Chile
